rationale: The Latin anchors *pittacium* (a patch/piece of cloth), *commissura* (a joining/seam), and *lamina* (a thin plate/layer) all point to a physical piece of material used to cover or mend something. The WordNet synset patch.n.03 ("a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole") is the closest match, directly reflecting the sewing/cloth-patch sense attested in the Old English glosses and homilies.
